description.label: Description
description.value:
Awarded For: Slaying at least 200 Skaven and a powerful Skaven champion, such as a Grey Seer Lord, Master Assassin, Master Moulder, Warlock Chief Engineer or Warlord.

Description: An iron medallion, inlaid with bronze with the image of a rat’s head with two ‘X’ marks over its eyes, and the heraldry of House Zelt emblazoned onto the back of the medal.

Bonuses: The wearer of this medal’s melee attacks against Rats and Skaven gain the Damaging Weapon Quality, and the wearer gains a bonus of +10 to all Psychology Tests related to Rats and Skaven. If the melee weapon already has Damaging it is replaced with the Impact Quality instead when striking Skaven.

Automation (Wave 3): Until automated, the GM applies the bonuses above manually when the medal is worn (Imperial Honors) or when the honor applies (Kill Counts).

Medal Notes

Talents granted by medals apply only to the original recipient. Non-talent bonuses require the medal to be worn by the earner. Non-earners do not gain these benefits — the GM enforces recipient rules (no automatic earner lock). Medals can be identified with Easy (+40) Lore (Empire / Heraldry / History). Fake medals: Evaluate + Numismatics (GM difficulty).
